decisions.statement: Every body read through here goes through one decoder.
Bytes that are not text say nothing rather than a replacement character.
Bytes with a zero byte spell no text.
A caller wanting those bytes read anyway reaches for a decoder that is lenient.
Eight bytes at the most are said in hex.
Nothing here knows which file the bytes came from or the meaning of the text.

definition: bytes as the text they spell, and the first of them in hex where they spell none
